body: Invited by SDU in Vejle to present in a research seminar my talk on “A Smart Architecture: AI-Driven Issue Management & Optimization”.
Received the Best Artifact Award at ICSA 2026 for “Supporting Architecture-Level Resilience Analysis With an Integrated Chaos and Load Experimentation Framework.”
Five papers accepted for 2026 — at ICSA, ASE, MODELS, SIGCSE TS, and ICSE-SEET — spanning resilience analysis, model-driven optimisation, and gamified education.
Joined the School of Computation, Information and Technology at the Technical University of Munich as a postdoctoral researcher.
Completed my doctorate (Dr. rer. nat.), graded summa cum laude, at the University of Stuttgart on issue management and propagation analysis for component-based systems — read the dissertation ↗.
